name: Durable
summary: AI website builder for small businesses that includes hosting, CRM, booking and marketing tools.
description: Durable generates a business website with AI in seconds and bundles hosting, a CRM, online booking, invoicing and marketing tools such as SEO and AI search visibility. It targets service businesses such as coaches and tradespeople. The Free plan covers a basic site; the Launch plan costs $25 per month and adds a custom domain, more AI credits and priority support.
